title: SQLite reads discard columns required to recreate empty tables
reasoning: SQLiteHandler.read represents each table solely as a list of rows. An empty table becomes an empty list, from which write cannot deduce any columns. The writer then rejects the reader's output, preventing materialization of otherwise valid databases containing empty tables.
reproduction: Read a database containing CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER) with no rows, then pass the returned content to SQLiteHandler.write; it raises InputFileWriteError.
recommendation: Include column metadata in the reader's table payload using the writer's supported columns/rows representation.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise metrics models rather than SQLite file round trips.
suggestedRegressionTest: Round-trip databases with populated tables, empty tables, and mixtures of both; verify table names, columns, and rows survive.
